caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which appears to be a carved stick or rod, laid horizontally across the center of a plain, light-colored background. The stick is brown in color and has a textured, spiral pattern on the left end, which is thicker than the rest of the stick. Moving to the right, the stick narrows and features irregular, vine-like carvings or protrusions along its length, adding to the surface detail. The right end of the stick tapers to a point and has a smoother appearance compared to the textured left end. The drawing is realistic in style, with careful attention to the color variations and texture of the wood. On the right side, near the object, there is a small signature reading "Edmund R. Lisas." There are no other objects or markings on the off-white background.
title: Cane
